Messages.Author: M.Schumacher
Messages.Body:
Mimir bleeds for 4.
Can I play Archon Investigation to burn Mimir? (I guess the answer is pretty clearly no.)
Can I play Archon Investigation to make the action unsuccessful?
(Ignroing the "Burn the acting minion" part of AI)

Mimir
Sabbat Cardinal
Ohter Methuselahs cannot play Master Cards that target Mimir.+1 bleed.

Archon Investiagtion
Master: out-of-turn. Only usable when a minion is attempting to bleed you for more than 3. The action is not successful. Burn the acting minion.

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: You cannot play archon investigation at all when Mimir is acting.

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Is "burn the acting minion" really targetting the minion?

National Coordinator Germany  nc [dot] germany [at] magenta [dot] de

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answer from Klaital: You cannot play Archon Investigation on Mimir.

> Hakuron wrote:
> Is "burn the acting minion" really targetting the minion?
>
Yes. It's important to remember that Secure Haven would affect Archon Investigation's cost:
[LSJ 20010817]

Name: Secure Haven
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location. Haven.
Put this card on a minion you control. This minion cannot be the target of other Methuselahs' actions. Any Methuselah burns an additional pool when playing master cards on (or that target) this minion. Burn this card if this minion enters torpor. A minion may have only one haven.

Messages.Author: AaronC
Messages.Body:
Where is there a link to a discussion on what "targeting" means in VTES? The use of the term "target/targeting" seems so useful when writing card text, but it is not defined in the rules or card text, AFAIK.

For instance, do reaction cards such as Deflection or Ignis Fatuus "target" the affected minion? I was creating card text for a homebrew crypt card, and I was interested to know if you could say "Reaction cards that require  may not target [this vampire]"

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: I believe you should word it as 'Reaction cards that require  may not be played while this vampire is acting.

Messages.Author: AaronC
Messages.Body:
> Klaital wrote:
> I believe you should word it as 'Reaction cards that require  may not be played while this vampire is acting.
>
So you know for certain that reaction cards do not "target"?
